title: Stateful AI Credential & Token Vault
goal: For the AI to chain attacks, it needs a memory bank for secrets. Create an ephemeral, run-scoped vault. If the AI discovers a hardcoded API key, cracks a password, or extracts a session cookie (e.g., via Gruyere XSS), it stores it here. The AI Planner then automatically injects these vaulted credentials into all subsequent runners (ZAP, Nuclei, Ffuf) to unlock authenticated attack surfaces.
generation_reason: To differentiate AegisPT from flat vulnerability scanners by enabling the AI to act like a human pentester: chaining initial findings to breach deeper layers of the application.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Ensure the pivoting mechanism stays strictly within the authorized Rules of Engagement (ROE) boundaries.

success_criteria: AI can extract a token and pass it to a subsequent authenticated scan.
AI identifies a pivot point (like SSRF) and generates a sub-plan.
The Gruyere benchmark passes by successfully chaining 3+ vulnerabilities.

acceptance_criteria: The local Gruyere chaining benchmark passes autonomously.

out_of_scope: Automated lateral movement outside the approved target scope
